seoTitle: Jeffco Public Schools Calendar 2025–26: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: See Jeffco Public Schools 2025–26 dates, including first and last days, breaks, snow make-up dates, teacher staff development days, PDF, and calendar download.
schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Jeffco Public Schools dates for 2025–26, including first day, last day, breaks, teacher staff development days, potential snow make-up days, legal holidays, and last-day early dismissal.
heroSummary: Jeffco Public Schools starts the 2025–26 school year for all students on Tuesday, August 19, 2025. The last day is Thursday, May 28, 2026. Jeffco says district-run PK-12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours earlier than their regular dismissal time on the last day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–28, 2025; Winter Break runs December 22, 2025–January 6, 2026; and Spring Break runs March 23–27, 2026.
calendarNotes: Jeffco’s 2025–26 family calendar marks March 30 and April 24 as potential snow make-up days. The PDF also says additional modified contact days are identified on individual school calendars, so families should verify school-level schedules separately.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against the Jeffco calendar page and the official 2025–26 English family calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked the first day, last day, student contact-day counts, teacher workday counts, breaks, legal holidays, teacher staff development days, potential snow make-up days, and last-day dismissal notice.
The PDF lists 80 first-semester student contact days and 91 second-semester student contact days.
The last-day dismissal notice applies to district-run PK-12 schools. The PDF tells charter families to contact their school directly for dismissal information.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco Public Schools starts the 2025–26 school year for all students on Tuesday, August 19, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Jeffco in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Thursday, May 28, 2026. Jeffco says district-run PK-12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours earlier than their regular dismissal time.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Jeffco in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025, through Tuesday, January 6, 2026. Students return Wednesday, January 7.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Jeffco in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23, through Friday, March 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Jeffco dates are potential snow make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The 2025–26 family calendar lists March 30 and April 24 as potential snow make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Jeffco calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import and will not automatically update if Jeffco Public Schools revises the calendar.

customSections.label: How the Jeffco Calendar Works
customSections.content: Jeffco’s family calendar includes several notes that affect planning beyond the first and last day. Potential snow make-up days may change if the district needs instructional time, modified contact days may be set by individual schools, and the last-day early dismissal rule is written for district-run PK-12 schools.

rows: March 30 and April 24 are listed with asterisks, so confirm district updates before treating them as final days off.
District-run PK-12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours earlier than regular dismissal time on May 28.
The PDF says charter families should contact their school directly for May 28 dismissal information.
Additional modified contact days are identified on individual school calendars.
